slot_scores.name: training_capacity_per_jet
slot_scores.evidence_quote: What is the exact rule linking jets allocated to training in a given year to the number of pilots trained (for example, does each training jet train exactly one pilot per year, or is there a different ratio or duration)?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked about the per-jet pilot training ratio/capacity, directly targeting the hidden slot.

slot_scores.name: pilot_to_combat_jet_mapping
slot_scores.rationale: The agent did not ask how many combat jets a trained pilot can operate or otherwise clarify the pilot-to-combat-jet mapping.

slot_scores.name: training_duration_and_start
slot_scores.evidence_quote: What is the exact rule linking jets allocated to training in a given year to the number of pilots trained (for example, does each training jet train exactly one pilot per year, or is there a different ratio or duration)?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent touched on duration in the context of the training rule, but did not clearly ask when training starts or confirm the 2-year training program duration.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Training starts in year 1 and pilots are counted as trained by the end of year 2, with no separate multi-year training duration beyond annual training output.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent did not explicitly confirm the start year or duration of the training program; it inferred the timeline from the objective and annual training-fleet dynamics.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The P0 training-capacity slot was resolved, but the P1 training start/duration slot was only partially addressed and not explicitly confirmed before READY_TO_MODEL.

summary: The agent recovered the critical per-jet training capacity and clarified several fleet-dynamics details, but it stopped without fully resolving the P1 training start/duration slot and never asked about the P2 pilot-to-combat-jet mapping.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
